data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 天台夕阳下的吉他包回眸
data.description: 放学后Livehouse所在建筑的天台，橙红色晚霞洒满铁丝网与水塔。虹夏单肩背着乐器包回过身来，金色的侧马尾与呆毛在强烈的逆光晚风中欢快跳动。她一手按住被风吹拂的衬衫衣领，向你展露出充满阳光感染力与无限信赖的灿烂笑颜。
data.location: industrial city rooftop with chain-link fence at golden hour
data.action: turning back on rooftop against vivid sunset sky, holding strap of music case, wind blowing golden side ponytail and ahoge, radiant heartwarming smile
data.lighting: dramatic golden hour backlighting creating glowing halo around hair
data.mood: uplifting sunny companionship, youthful musical passion
data.promptProse: Turning around on a breezy rooftop bathed in vivid orange sunset light, Nijika Ijichi carries a musical gear case over one shoulder. Her golden side ponytail dances in the wind as she beams with an infectious, caring smile.
data.animaCaption: Nijika turning back on a rooftop at sunset, her golden side ponytail catching the golden light.
